name: Snowball Blooms Atop Snowfields
desc: A classic layered salad. Each ingredient is prepared separately, then stacked in layers with seasoned sour cream dressing spread between them. Once assembled, the salad is usually left to rest for a while so the flavors can fully meld. The finished dish resembles clusters of snowball blooms blooming over a snowy field, which is how it earned its name.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 194 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
